title: SB0823 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, relative to weapons.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2023-01-30; crossfiled twin https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/113/Bill/HB0795.pdf is the same printed document (it names SENATE BILL 823); copied from TN-HB-795-2023.draft.txt)
provenance.note: Draft of 2023-01-30 (as introduced); amendments not in text. Text is only a word swap; the summary says the offense is carrying a weapon where judicial proceedings are in progress. Weapon includes firearms but is not gun-only. Twin: TN-HB-795-2023.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1306(a)): is amended by deleting the language "any building" and substituting instead the language "a room".
